fotos.texto: You need at least {minimo} cards for your pack: photos or memories without a photo. Photos in JPG, PNG, HEIC or WEBP.
fotos.consentimiento: I have permission from the people in the photos, and from their parents if they are minors, to use them in this deck.
fotos.consentimientoFalta: Tick the permission box to add photos.
fotos.soltar: Drop photos or a whole folder here
fotos.privacidad: Photos never leave this device: we read the dates right here.
fotos.procesadas: {n, plural, one {# photo added} other {# photos added}}
fotos.repetidas: {n, plural, one {# repeated photo was skipped} other {# repeated photos were skipped}}
fotos.errores: {n, plural, one {# file couldn’t be read} other {# files couldn’t be read}}
fotos.sinEspacio: {n, plural, one {# photo didn’t fit on this device: free up some space and add it again} other {# photos didn’t fit on this device: free up some space and add them again}}
fotos.vacio: No photos or memories yet. Start with a folder from a trip or a year.

sinFoto.texto: The day you met, Grandpa’s birth… Write the memory and its date. It costs the same as a photo card.
sinFoto.pregunta: Missing any memories without a photo?
sinFoto.preguntaAyuda: Tap an idea to add it, or write your own.

fotos.conFechaCuenta: {n, plural, one {# with a date} other {# with a date}}
fotos.sugeridasCuenta: {n, plural, one {# with a suggested date} other {# with a suggested date}}
fotos.sinFechaCuenta: {n, plural, one {# without a date} other {# without a date}}
fotos.revisarCuenta: {n, plural, one {# to check} other {# to check}}
fotos.sugeridasAyuda: We only fill in a date when we’re sure. Check the suggested ones, or use them all at once.
fotos.usarSugeridas: {n, plural, one {Use the suggested date} other {Use the # suggested dates}}
fotos.sugeridasUsadas: {n, plural, one {# suggested date set.} other {# suggested dates set.}}
fotos.sesionEscaneo: {n} photos share the same recent suggested date, {fecha}. If they’re old photos you scanned or photographed that day, that’s the date of the copy: add the date of the memory instead.

fechas.precision: What do you know about the date?
fechas.futura: The date can’t be later than today.
fechas.incompleta: {precision, select, dia {The day or month is missing. If you don’t know them, choose “Month and year” or “Just the year”.} other {The month is missing. If you don’t know it, choose “Just the year”.}}

motivo.fecha-del-archivo: It’s the file’s date: it may be when it was copied, not when the photo was taken.
motivo.fecha-de-hoy: It’s today’s date: probably when you copied the photo.
motivo.exif-y-nombre-no-coinciden: The photo’s details and the file name don’t match.
motivo.reloj-de-camara: It looks like the date of a camera whose clock was never set.
motivo.posible-escaneo: This looks like a scanned or digitised photo: its date is when it was scanned, not when the memory happened.
motivo.digitalizada-despues: The photo keeps this as its original date, although it was digitised later.
motivo.fecha-anotada: Someone noted this date in the photo’s details.
motivo.fecha-reciente: It’s from the past year. If it’s an old photo you recently photographed or scanned, it’s the date of the copy.
motivo.fecha-de-envio: It’s when the photo was sent or saved (WhatsApp, Telegram…), which may be after the memory.
motivo.captura-de-pantalla: It’s when the screenshot was taken, which may be after the memory.
motivo.sin-datos-de-camara: The photo has this date but no camera details: it may be the date of a copy or an edit.
motivo.fecha-digitalizacion: It’s when the photo was saved digitally. For camera photos it’s usually the same day.

fechas.vacia: This card doesn’t have a date yet.
fechas.escribela: Add it yourself: just the year is fine if that’s all you know.
fechas.eligeOEscribe: {n, plural, one {Use the suggested date or type your own.} other {Use one of these dates or type your own.}}
fechas.aplicarA: Set this date on {n, plural, one {# photo} other {# photos}}
